faq_plan.q: What is a real estate buyer intake form?
How do I create a real estate buyer intake form?

faq_heading: Real Estate Buyer Intake Form FAQ

plan.angle: The top 10 for this query is printables: Pinterest pins, Etsy and Canva templates at $7 to $10, a printable PDF and two blog templates. Each hands an agent a static list of questions. This page shows a buyer intake that acts on its answers: it books a consultation for buyers without a preapproval letter, flags relocations with a tight move date, assigns each buyer to the right agent on a team, and puts the written buyer agreement on the last screen so it is signed before the first tour.
tab_stories: A first-time buyer tells Ansel Park Realty she has no preapproval letter yet, so the form offers her a 30-minute buyer consultation before any showing request opens.
A buyer relocating for a new job enters a move date 32 days out, and because it falls within 45 days, Brookfield Realty's agent gets a Slack message and the buyer is offered live video tours.
Larkspur Realty's team intake reads each buyer's area and budget, sends each buyer to the agent who covers that area, and gives any budget of $800,000 or more to the luxury lead.

Willow Gate Realty ends its intake with the written buyer agreement, and the buyer's showing requests open only after she signs it, because MLS participants working with a buyer need that agreement before a tour.
